issue.title: [bug] 在会话不显示 MiniMax Code 的会话
issue.body:
## 需求描述

MiniMax Code 的会话在 Magpie「会话」页面中没有正常显示对应的用量信息，无法按具体会话查看请求与上下文用量。

## 期望结果

希望「会话」页面能把 MiniMax Code 的会话与对应的用量数据关联起来，并正常展示每个会话的请求数、Token 用量及可用的上下文用量信息。如果某类数据无法从会话记录中取得，也希望界面明确说明支持范围。

## 查看方式

1. 在 MiniMax Code 中产生若干轮对话。
2. 打开 Magpie 的「会话」页面，查看对应的 MiniMax Code 会话及其用量信息。

## 补充

这项需求关注的是**会话页面中的展示与会话关联**，与 #1605 中 MiniMax Code 请求计入 Agent 用量的统计覆盖问题不同。当前未提供 Magpie / MiniMax Code 版本、操作系统及会话页面具体表现截图，后续可补充以便复现。

comments.body:
问题原因：MiniMax Code 的会话目录（`v2/sessions/<年>/<月>/<日>/<时间>-session_<base64>/messages.jsonl`）只被 Usage 的调用读取器读过（`internal/sessions/calls_minimax.go`，#1605），Sessions 页的 `allFiles`（`internal/sessions/sessions.go`）没有列这个目录，`parserFor` 也没有 `minimax-code` 的解析器，所以「会话」页里根本没有对应的行，也就无法把会话和用量关联起来。

改动：新增 `internal/sessions/minimax.go`，每个会话读一次 `messages.jsonl`——会话 id 取文件夹名里解码出的 `mvs_…`，与 Usage 调用记录里的 `session` 相同，因此两边能对上；标题取 MiniMax Code 自己的 `<system-reminder>` 包装之后的第一条用户输入；每个模型的 input/output/cache 用量、时间与消息数来自各条 assistant 消息的 `usage` 与 `timestamp`。`minimaxSessionFiles` 接进 `allFiles`，`parseMiniMax` 接进 `parserFor`；会话目录的遍历与 `calls_minimax.go` 共用一个函数，Usage 仍读所有历史代际，列表只读 `messages.jsonl`，避免同一条回复被计两次。按会话的请求数仍由 Usage 的请求账本给出（#1605 已按同一个 session id 计入）。

文件里没有的信息不做猜测：没有工作目录、没有可用的 resume 命令，`Deletable` 仍为 false，所以页面沿用现有提示，说明 magpie 只能列出 MiniMax Code 的会话、不能 resume 或删除，这也就是该 agent 当前的支持范围。`docs/subsystems/gateway-sessions.md` 已写明一行有什么、没有什么。

分支：[fix/2301-minimax-code](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/2301-minimax-code)，commit 1ce1eca899ac47e5434da67df98a8b0e4c133be3

已验证：新增 `TestMiniMaxCodeSessionsListed`（用仓库内 `testdata/minimax` 里报告者留下的两个真实 `messages.jsonl`），撤回 `allFiles` 里那一行后失败 `want MiniMax Code's two sessions, got 0: []`，恢复后通过；`go test ./internal/sessions/ ./internal/cli/ -count=1` 与 `go test ./internal/gui/ -count=1` 通过；`gofmt -l` 无输出，`go build ./...`、`go vet ./...`、`GOOS=linux`（含 `-tags nogui`）与 `GOOS=windows` 的 vet/build 均通过。未验证：MiniMax Code 桌面端自己写出的文件（用的是 #1605 沙盒运行留下的样本）、压缩之后的会话，以及 WSL 里的 MiniMax Code。

这是 fork 上的分支，供 review，不代表该 issue 的归属。

Thanks for the branch (#2301). Some notes from a machine that runs the MiniMax Code desktop app, and one confirmation on the current main.

**Still open on current main.** On `main` at d4202898f (2026-11-10), `allFiles` (`internal/sessions/sessions.go`) lists every other agent's session files and not MiniMax Code's, and `parserFor` (same file) has no `minimax-code` case, so a session folder under `v2/sessions` is still read for Usage alone and the Sessions page has no MiniMax Code tab.

**The desktop app's own files — the case the branch says is untried.** MiniMax Code 3.1.7 on macOS arm64 writes `~/.minimax/v2/sessions/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<hh-mm-ss-ms>-session_<base64>/`, and a session folder holds `manifest.json`, `messages.jsonl`, `history-catalog.json`, `user-message-locators.jsonl`, `llm-call.json`, plus `ledger.jsonl`, `display.jsonl`, `snapshot.json` and `reports/` for the older ones. The assistant messages carry `api, content, model, provider, responseId, role, stopReason, timestamp, usage`, so #1605's reader (`mcodeLine`) takes them as it takes the sandbox sample; every assistant message here carries a `usage`. The providers seen are `minimax` and `custom_provider:*`, and the gateway's own `custom_provider:magpie` does not appear, which is what the branch's filter expects.

Two points the real data raises, where "read `messages.jsonl` alone" decides what is shown:

1. **19 of 130 session folders have no `messages.jsonl` at all** — same `layout: v2-final-dated-session`, same `source: local-runtime`. Their messages are in `ledger.jsonl`, as events carrying a `message` object (`role`, `msg_content`, `timestamp`, and a `usage` of the older shape: `total_tokens` and `context_window`, with no input/output split). Those sessions are in neither the Sessions page nor Usage today. If the listing is to cover them, `ledger.jsonl` needs its own reader; if it is not to, the page should say which shape it supports. #1605's reader misses them for the same reason.

2. **`history-catalog.json` names the older generations in a way that does not start with `messages`** — `g000000000000--ctx_<uuid>.jsonl` and the like, one per artifact (`kind: snapshot`), 46 of them here. Those files are no longer on disk (0 of 46 present), so the call reader's `messages*` prefix misses nothing today; but the comment in `calls_minimax.go` says the reader also takes "any other generation of it the session's `history-catalog.json` keeps beside it", which the code does not do — it walks the folder and matches the file name. Worth either reading the catalog or correcting the comment.

Two smaller notes that may help the branch:

- The session id needs no base64 decoding: `manifest.json`'s `sessionId` matched the decoded folder name in 130 of 130 folders here (`mvs_…`), so the manifest is the more direct source.
- The working directory is really not in the files, which agrees with the branch's "not guessed": only 36 of 111 folders carry a `YOUR WORKSPACE DIRECTORY:` line inside the `<agent-context>` block of a user message, and most of those are the default `~/.minimax/workspace` rather than a project directory.

I can add a fixture of the desktop app's own files (sanitized) to the branch's tests, if that helps — the two `messages.jsonl` under `testdata/minimax` are from the #1605 sandbox run, and the desktop app's shape is the one described above.
